== Dead stuff ==

These are abandoned projects or just broken links. If you are the author of one of the projects listed here, and that project is <u>not</u> dead, merely the link is broken, please fix it!
* Broken link: [http://valfahi.balvi.org valfa'i] - An online dictionary.
* Broken link: [http://www.codedbliss.com/lojban/zanfahi/ zanfa'i] - Another online dictionary, also for download.
* Broken link: [http://www.codedbliss.com/lojban/selylergahi/ selylerga'i] - online lojban orthography convertor (currently Latin -> Arabic, Tengwar, Turkish, or IPA).
* Broken link: [http://cec.wustl.edu/~adam/lojban/mlismu/ mlismu] is [[Eimi]]'s fact-based lojban random sentence generator. additions to fatci.txt are welcome!

** the code is now [http://github.com/timo/mlismu hosted on github!] (not broken)
* Contains broken links: [[bancus|bancus]] wrote an IRC bot to play a game similar to 5x5 called [[mumym|mumym]]
* [[The Lojban MOO|The Lojban MOO]] was an ambitious MUD

=== Flashcard Programs ===
NOTE: Smart.fm has ceased to be free.
*[[File:832.sip]]  [http://www.coirodo.com] A wonder full website featuring a children's book in lojban and other lojbanic resources.
*[[File:832.sip]] Smart.fm - [http://smart.fm/goals/266809 Lojban gismu] (all-inclusive), [http://smart.fm/goals/268251 Lojban gismu - place structure] (only the gismu), and [http://smart.fm/goals/279583 Lojban gismu - per-place sumti] (only gismu sumti) - These three sites on Smart.fm are for learning the gismu and each of the sumti places of each gismu through Smart.fm's "iKnow!" or "Drill Beta" spaced repetition programs.
*[[File:832.sip]] Smart.fm - [http://smart.fm/goals/292653 Lojban cmavo, with no compounds], and [http://smart.fm/goals/284287 Lojban cmavo, with some compounds], the second has the more often used "compound cmavo" such as {.ienai}

*[[File:831.sip]] [[File:829.sip]] [http://supermemo.com Supermemo] is a fantastic way to learn Lojban. Robin has made a list of words, more information available [http://www.digitalkingdom.org/~rlpowell/hobbies/lojban/ here].
** Supermemo has Windows (including Windows CE) and Palmpilot versions.
** There is a [http://www.supermemo.com/articles/soft/sm7.htm ree version of Supermemo for Windows]. It runs well under Wine for Linux.
*** Save [http://www.digitalkingdom.org/~rlpowell/hobbies/lojban/flashcards/big_list_supermemo_win.txt his] as list.txt. Run Supermemo, create a new database, choose options->go professional then tools->import text and import list.txt. Then start learning!
*[[File:831.sip]] [[File:830.sip]] [[File:829.sip]] [http://mnemosyne-proj.sf.net Mnemosyne] is a Supermemo-like open source program based on spaced repetition. Here is a deck of flashcards for it, with the English gloss word on the front and the corresponding Lojban word and definition on the back: {file name="lojban.mem" page="Software assisted learning"} And here's a different deck, this time with the Lojban word on the front (tab-separated; use Mnemosyne's "import" function): {file name="mnemosyne.txt" page="Software assisted learning" desc="vocabulary list for mnemosyne"}
*[[File:832.sip]] [http://quizlet.com/group/152/ Quizlet], a website for learning vocabulary, with some Lojban vocabulary imported
*[[File:832.sip]] [http://rememberize.com/search/tag/lojban Rememberize], another web-based flashcard site with Lojban vocabulary imported
*[[File:831.sip]] [[Jay Kominek]]'s [http://ucsub.colorado.edu/~kominek/lojban/flashlojban.pl perl flashcard script] (It requires some other software on [http://ucsub.colorado.edu/~kominek/lojban/ his Lojban page] to generate the data files)
*[[File:831.sip]] [[File:829.sip]] Various software (DOS, primarily) is described and accessible at [http://www.lojban.org/files/roadmap.html#software], including Logflash (a flashcard program), and the official parser.
*[[File:831.sip]] [[File:829.sip]] [[File:logflash-linux-files.tar.gz|Lojbanic Software]]

[[File:832.sip]] [http://riad.de/jmemorize/ Memorize] is a simple and user-friendly flashcard program. See the [[jMemorize instructions]] page.

[[File:832.sip]] [[gismutrainer]] is a command-line tool for learning gismus, uses python.

[[File:832.sip]] [http://mysite.verizon.net/res8szeo/numbertrainer.html umber trianer] A simple program that helps you memorise lojban words that are associated with numbers.

== Logflash Files ==

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/f flashdoc.txt]:Internal program documentation, somewhat out of date, for LogFlash. Probably useful to anyone trying to modify the source.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/f flashman.txt]:A description of the flashcard management process used as the basis for LogFlash - essentially an algorithm statement for the program.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/l lfsrc.ZIP]:The Turbo-Pascal source for the current version of LogFlash 1 (LF3 differs only in changing some constant parameters).

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/l logflash.zip]:LogFlash, a computer-aided instruction program for teaching Lojban gismu. This is an MS-DOS executable with support files.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/l logfl3.zip]:LogFlash 3, a computer-aided instruction program for teaching Lojban cmavo. This is an MS-DOS executable with support files.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/l logflash.txt]:A description of the LogFlash algorithm at the user level. The current version is described. LogFlash 2,mentioned in the text, is being brought up to the current language standard, but is not yet available.


== Old Lojban Software ==
;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/a analyser]:The source code (in Prolog) for Nick Nicholas's Lojban Semantic Analyser.
;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/B BRKWORDS.EXE]:An implementation of the Lojban word-resolution algorithm, which is described in [http://www.lojban.org/files/software/B BRKWORDS.TXT]. The source for this program is in [http://www.lojban.org/files/software/B BRKWORDS.PAS].
;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/g gloss3-2.ZIP]:The Lojban Parser/Glosser. This program takes grammatical Lojban text and translates it word for word into an English gloss, including identifying case tags for the sumti of all gismu that are used. The file includes the up to date Lojban parser.
;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/l lujvomak.zip]:The Lojban lujvo-making and analysis program. This program allows you to make lujvo given the source metaphor (English keywords) or to analyze a lujvo into its component metaphor. There are drill modes that generate random lujvo to test your word making and analysis skills.
;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/r rndsen28.zip]:This is an obsolete version of the Lojban random sentence generator, based on the 2.8 version of the grammar. A new version is being worked on. Most of the sentences that this program generates will be correct Lojban.
;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/s scrabble.zip]:This is an attempt to make a Lojban compatible version of the Scrabble (tm) word game. Letter frequencies are based on frequencies in Lojban words.
;[http://www.lojban.org/files/software/g gunzip.exe]:The GUNZIP program, used to uncompress .gz files.
